subject: Lower per-field info definition log from WARNING to DEBUG (#1281)
reason: The change only lowers the log level of a per-field 'Defined Info Field' diagnostic message from WARNING to DEBUG in vmsdk/src/info.cc. It alters no command behavior, replies, data, replication, or configuration — just server log verbosity, which the fuzzer's oracles do not observe. There is no reachable behavioral difference to test, so no scenario is needed.
